name: IRIS Unified Risk Profile Policy
description: Deterministic rules for profile status, coverage, priority, attention, and human-review recommendations.

aggregation_mandate.rationale: Domains have distinct target semantics, divergent base rates, and differing governance statuses. Cost overrun is NOT_READY_FOR_PRODUCTION, and Implementation Risk lacks a serialized production artifact. Arbitrary aggregation is scientifically invalid and masks critical risk dimensions.

FULL.interpretation: Complete predictive intelligence available across all domains.

PARTIAL.interpretation: At least one domain is available, some domains are unavailable due to model governance, and none are structurally ineligible.

LIMITED.interpretation: Risk prediction exists for some domains, but structural source omissions render one or more domains ineligible.

UNAVAILABLE.interpretation: No domain risk predictions are available for this observation.

INELIGIBLE.interpretation: All domains are structurally ineligible for this observation.

levels.HIGH_PRIORITY: status == 'AVAILABLE' and risk_score >= 0.50 (meets operational decision threshold)
levels.UNAVAILABLE: status == 'NOT_AVAILABLE' (unassessed; strictly never treated as low risk)

attention_level_rules.HIGH_ATTENTION: At least one available domain is HIGH_PRIORITY
attention_level_rules.MEDIUM_ATTENTION: No HIGH_PRIORITY, but at least one available domain is MEDIUM_PRIORITY
attention_level_rules.LIMITED_ASSESSMENT: All available domains are LOW_PRIORITY, but coverage is incomplete (PARTIAL_COVERAGE or LIMITED_COVERAGE)
attention_level_rules.ROUTINE: All domains are assessed under COMPLETE_COVERAGE and all are LOW_PRIORITY

recommendations_inventory.REVIEW_SCHEDULE_RISK: Triggered when schedule extension risk is elevated (HIGH_PRIORITY or MEDIUM_PRIORITY).
recommendations_inventory.COST_RISK_NOT_PRODUCTION_READY: Triggered because cost overrun domain is governed as NOT_READY_FOR_PRODUCTION.
recommendations_inventory.INSUFFICIENT_DOMAIN_COVERAGE: Triggered when coverage is PARTIAL_COVERAGE, LIMITED_COVERAGE, or NO_PREDICTIVE_COVERAGE.
recommendations_inventory.IMPLEMENTATION_MODEL_LIMITATIONS: Triggered when implementation risk is NOT_AVAILABLE due to lack of a serialized production artifact.
recommendations_inventory.STRUCTURAL_ELIGIBILITY_LIMITATION: Triggered when implementation risk is INELIGIBLE due to structural column absence in source reports.
